name: 意式极简真皮软包床款
description: 暗木开篇加奶咖细铜体系，皮面侧光质感与双坐感收口套图

styleLock.direction: italian-minimal premium soft-furniture commerce, editorial dark-to-light rhythm
styleLock.backgroundSystem: 三套背景轮换且全组统一：无缝奶灰摄影墙 #E9E5DE、实景胡桃木饰面墙 #4C3B2E、墨黑信息图场 #101010；地面只用微水泥 #CFC9C0 或宽板木地板 #B99C7E，家具落地面必带真实接触阴影
styleLock.lightingSystem: 大面积柔光自机位左侧进入，亮场 4500-5000K、暗场 3200K；皮面、缝线、木框一律用侧掠光交代肌理，阴影侧用反光板补光，禁止硬高光与矛盾光向
styleLock.surfaceSystem: 微水泥地 #CFC9C0、宽板木地板 #B99C7E、羊毛短绒毯面，木饰面与皮面同侧受光，织物褶皱自然不修图过度
styleLock.typography: 中文现代几何无衬线 + 拉丁衬线展示行与字距拉开的 eyebrow 小字；标题 28-44pt、副标 16-20pt、标签 10-14pt，所有画面文案一律以占位符渲染，禁止照搬原文案
styleLock.iconSystem: 单一线宽细线图标，铜环圆形材质样片 #C2A15C，仅用线性勾选/叉选符号；禁止证书徽章、奖牌、二维码等图形
styleLock.presentationRules: 首屏与主图共用同一 3/4 锚定机位保证同一件产品读感；全组显式声明机位与占比；全景镜头不超过全组 40%；含至少一个俯视与一个仰视；皮质与缝线特写必须侧光
noDrift: no brand marks, QR codes or membership badges
no invented certifications, measurements, grades or year figures
styleLock.lockText: Campaign Style Lock: consistent premium Italian-minimal soft-furniture ecommerce visual system across the entire image set; fixed palette of warm base #F5F2EC, base ink #101010 and base walnut veneer #4C3B2E, with greige #A89084 as the soft secondary and brass #C2A15C as the only accent; warm tone, 3200K on dark screens and 4500-5000K on bright screens; background system alternates a seamless greige studio wall #E9E5DE, a real walnut-veneer bedroom wall #4C3B2E and an ink infographic field #101010, always grounded on micro-cement #CFC9C0 or wide-plank floor #B99C7E with a real contact shadow; lighting system large soft key from camera left, raking side light across upholstery grain, stitching and wood frame, filled shadow side, never harsh speculars; typography one modern geometric sans-serif for Chinese copy plus a serif Latin display line, letterspaced eyebrow labels, headline 28-44pt, subtitle 16-20pt, label 10-14pt, all rendered copy as placeholder text inside brackets; layout system rounded cards at 16-24px radius, two-column callout grids, pill tags, 1px hairline rules, four-step timeline, diagonal-split cards; icon system single-weight thin line icons, brass-rimmed circular material swatches, check and cross glyphs only; product presentation rules one shared 3/4 anchor angle across screens, identical scale and contact-shadow behaviour, grain and stitching always lit from the same side; no color palette changes, no mixed fonts, no random backgrounds, no inconsistent lighting, no mismatched icon styles, no brand marks, no QR codes, no membership badges, no invented certifications, measurements, grades or year figures.

provenance.notes: 据 11 张详情页切片提炼。仅前两片含实拍（胡桃木饰面暗调实景中一件浅色软包、实木压边扶手的坐具/床尾视角），其余切片为版式与空白占位图块，故本模版只继承其视觉语法与版式骨架，不复制任何具体造型。品类判定以图为准：软体皮艺卧室家具，L1 取 家具家纺、L2 取 卧室家具；源夹名「家装家具家用品」与 taxonomy 的 L1 名称不符（taxonomy 无该大类），已在 L1 层面按图修正为 家具家纺。已剥离：原文案全部字句、店铺/会员标识与二维码、品牌字样、拉丁语占位文字、具体皮料产地与工艺道数。所有数值与主张（尺寸、皮质等级、承重、甲醛、工序数、使用年限、保修、软硬度档位、价格）一律以 {selling_point_*} / {callout_*} 占位，不编造认证与检测结论，凭证镜只留空相框版位。与库内 家具家纺 既有版（梳妆台 jiajujiafang-shuzhuangtai-yanban-shishimu-sansejing，浅色亮白实木梳妆台系）在主题上不同，视觉体系亦区隔：本版为暗胡桃木 + 墨黑信息场 + 奶咖 + 细铜的暖调编辑式体系，含黑底工序时间轴与斜切细节卡，不使用亮白粉调与镜面反射场景。机位分布：3/4 平视、仰视、高 45 度俯视、90 度侧面微距、正平视双栏、90 度俯视、45 度后侧共 7 类，全景镜 4/11 约 36%，含俯视与仰视各一，微距/特写 4 镜。
